changes.evidence: Two separate short horizontal ink strokes stand above and to the left of the first line. They are retained as margin marks; their hand and function are not established.
The interval between the M and N is blank. The visible commas in the later argument pairs descend below their letters; no comparable stroke occurs in this first pair.

A near-vertical stroke crosses a heavy transverse stroke. The lower part has a second horizontal level, so a retraced plus and a nearly vertical not-equal slash remain possible. No choice is made from the next clause.

There are two detached dark marks: a short upright upper mark and a larger lower blob. No clear bowl or outgoing letter stroke survives. Colon remains the first graphical reading, with an abbreviated à retained as an alternative.

Inside the parentheses the surviving lower stroke is an S-like curl, with a detached high stroke. It does not resolve into a complete star. The later body reference is visibly a star, but that is not substituted for this damaged mark.
The brace lies above the H term and has an upward central cusp. P(M,N) is written above the brace, not below the sequence.
The terminal curved mark touches the vertical copy edge. Its upper and lower arcs suggest 0, but its contour is incomplete; the final arrow itself is clear.

notes: This is an entirely handwritten continuation page on the upper/right part of a copied sheet. No independent author page number is visible. The H packet’s page 4 label is treated as editorial metadata, not imported into the transcription. The pencil foliation is 62.

Author claim: E′(M,N) has the same underlined H invariants as E(M,N) under the written degree condition, and degree 2 gives the displayed exact sequence. The comparison sign is not secure; its expected mathematical role has not decided the reading.

Author qualification: “Heuristiquement” introduces the 2-champ interpretation. The author explicitly says “en admettant que ta théorie” and “ce qui pour moi ne fait guère de doute”. The additional stricts qualification is interlinear.

The author claims the exact sequence can be constructed canonically “à la main”; the paragraph ends mid-sentence at “près des”. The word read classes is more strongly supported than H’s uncertain données, but compressed internal strokes retain a local doubt.

Mathematical ink inspections covered E versus E′, each argument separator, the detached dot of H^i, superscript 2 at Ext and H, the upward brace and P(M,N), sigma, every arrowhead and terminal mark, and the lowered 2 before N. These were transcription inspections, not proof verification.
The possible point before moi is carried in place with uncertainty. Its omission by both witnesses is not evidence against it, and its location alone does not establish intentional punctuation.

Twelve crops were made with the supplied crop.py, autocontrast, Lanczos enlargement to width 2800, and sharpening. No crop required rotation. Each unresolved locus was cropped once; the whole page and both supplied halves were each viewed once. No OCR, web, other page, other reader, or mathematical source was used.

Final syntax-only validation passed for balanced TeX braces, display and group delimiters, paired math delimiters, three insertion macros, full paragraph ending and foliation comment; report JSON and all evidence paths were validated. No LaTeX compilation was performed.

coverage: Read every line of both halves against the complete C and H texts, including agreement passages, accents, endings, punctuation, each argument list, every exponent/index, the full sequence, quotations, the three insertions, the definite erased mark and possible le cancellation. The whole-image view accounted for the margin strokes, copied-sheet edges, two curved impressions and lower pencil foliation. H loses physical insertion states, the cancelled preposition, the stricts underline and top marks; its brace is below rather than above, it supplies a comma in the first argument list and after the inserted N, and it reads la for ta and uncertain données for the best reading classes. C is largely retained but the display-label preference is reordered, the le state is made explicitly uncertain, classes receives a local doubt, and an uncertain small comma/dot before moi is added. No diagrams or author drawings occur on this page; the exact sequence is fully transcribed as a display. All unresolved places have one logged crop and all changed/reviewed loci have original-pixel source boxes.
